statements.status_notes: Docker Scout reports no fixed github.com/labstack/echo/v4 release for this CVE; the latest v4 tag on the Go module proxy is v4.16.2 and remains within the affected range. debian-13 1.28.x through 1.32.x embed echo v4.16.1 in the locally built temporal CLI. Clearing the finding requires an upstream echo v4 security release or a coordinated major-line upgrade of the temporal CLI.

github.com/labstack/echo/v4 is embedded in /usr/local/bin/docker-agent from the upstream docker-agent release binary installed by sbx-templates docker-agent kits. Docker Scout reports no fixed echo release for this CVE yet; remediation depends on a new upstream echo release and a docker-agent rebuild that includes it.
